exam.title: Terraform Associate (004)
exam.study_prerequisites: Basic terminal skills and an understanding of on-premises and cloud architecture; hands-on Terraform practice in a disposable environment is strongly recommended.

review.notes: All eight unweighted objective domains and 38 published subobjectives are mapped to the guide. All 33 cited URLs are exact source-catalog entries. Two O'Reilly Terraform course pages returned HTTP 403 to the automated monitor; they are treated as access-blocked rather than missing. HCP Terraform entitlements, limits, UI labels, and service capabilities remain explicitly marked VERIFY CURRENT.

findings.title: Secret changes require an update contract
findings.evidence: Omitted values cannot be diffed; providers define version-trigger behavior.
findings.recommendation: Explain version signal, persistence elsewhere and recovery.
findings.resolution: Explain version signal, persistence elsewhere and recovery.

findings.title: Remote storage alone does not enable locking
findings.evidence: S3 lockfile is opt-in; DynamoDB locking is deprecated.
findings.recommendation: Add lockfile permissions and compatible-writer migration context.
findings.resolution: Add lockfile permissions and compatible-writer migration context.
